The '''Benwabula system''' was located in the [[Shadola sector/Legends|Shadola sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was the origin point of the item known as the [[Benwabulan gong]].<ref name="MedStar">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Benwabulan gong]]|system=Benwabula [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Benwabula [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square U-7.<ref name="TEA" />
